    df = pd.read_csv(args.csv_path)
    first_col = df.columns[0]
    has_index_col = first_col == "" or str(first_col).startswith("Unnamed")

    model = sam_model_registry["vit_t"](checkpoint=args.weights_path)

    predictor = SamPredictor(model)

    cells = []

        xs, ys = parse_coords(row["coords_x"]), parse_coords(row["coords_y"])
        n = min(len(xs), len(ys))
